basic_info.description: Welcome to this exquisite 3 bedroom, 2 bath condo located in a gated community. Experience tranquility, privacy, and breathtaking bay views from the expansive balcony. The condo features a spacious master suite, a generous living room, new floor,  new quartz counter top, newly interior paint, laundry closet with washer/dryer, and two free parking spaces with an option for a third. Enjoy the convenience of a children's playground, and benefit from HOA covering water, garbage, and insurance. Easy commuting to Hwy 101, 280, San Francisco, Bart Station, and Caltrain Station. Don't miss this opportunity for an exceptional and convenient lifestyle
